setup.label: Getting started
setup.description: Who you are, how you relate to B9, and ground rules.

questions.text: Who is filling this out? (Your name is enough — no official title needed.)
questions.why: Personalizes the plan without assuming an org chart.

questions.text: What is your relationship to B9? (e.g. family, advisor, coordinator, owner, vendor)
questions.why: Clarifies influence and who else should be in the room.

questions.text: Who on the team would help implement changes you recommend?
questions.why: Identifies allies for adoption.

questions.text: What tools does B9 use today? (StaffConnect, email, accounting, CRM, comms)
questions.why: Determines augment vs integrate patterns.

questions.text: Across the business, where does work feel most stuck or manual right now?
questions.why: Surfaces the highest-level pain signal for prioritization.

questions.text: What should AI never do at B9? (hard lines)
questions.why: Captures non-negotiables for outcomes.

questions.text: Who needs to sign off before anything goes live?
questions.why: Clarifies approval chain.

questions.text: What would a good first 30 days look like?
questions.why: Sets near-term success criteria.

questions.text: Any channels or tools you're eager to wire together? (WhatsApp, SMS, Zapier, StaffConnect, email, other — describe the dream)
questions.why: Captures integration appetite without assuming it's ready to ship.

strategy.label: Business strategy
strategy.description: Eight owner-level questions that shape phasing. Best answered by Brenda or leadership.

questions.text: What % of B9's pipeline (last 12 months) came from RFP / procurement / supplier-registration channels vs warm intros, repeat clients, referrals?
questions.why: THE gating question — shapes Branch A priority.

questions.text: What is your 3-year ambition for B9? (Lifestyle / 2-3x growth / platform / exit-grooming / other)
questions.why: Sets strategic frame for all recommendations.

questions.text: Roughly how many retained/repeat clients in a typical quarter? How many active 1099 talent on the roster?
questions.why: Scale signals for expansion and talent tracks.

questions.text: What is your single biggest operational pain right now — what would you change tomorrow?
questions.why: Unprompted pain drives branch and top-3 selection.

questions.text: Where does B9 talent live geographically? Rough mix of NYC, Illinois, California talent and bookings.
questions.why: Triggers compliance flags (NYC LL 144, IL HB 3773, CA ADMT).

questions.text: Current tech stack and any 6-12 month plans to change tools?
questions.why: Augment vs buy vs integrate.

questions.text: How does your team feel about AI handling talent communications directly? (Open / cautious / off-limits)
questions.why: Gates Group D talent experience use cases.

questions.text: What would success look like 6 months from now if any of this works?
questions.why: Sets KPI baseline and stop/continue criteria.

wf_marketing.label: Marketing / Demand Gen
wf_marketing.description: How leads arrive — SEO, partnerships, RFP portals, referrals.

questions.text: Marketing / Demand Gen — How do new leads find B9 today? Who owns follow-up?
questions.why: Maps the top of the funnel before AI recommendations.

questions.text: Where is the most manual work in this phase? (content, outreach, list building, etc.)
questions.why: Surfaces automation candidates tied to this workflow.

questions.text: What would "better" look like here in 90 days?
questions.why: Sets a measurable target for this process.

wf_discovery.label: Discovery / Scoping
wf_discovery.description: Inquiry handling and qualification — first 24–72 hours.

questions.text: Discovery / Scoping — Walk through what happens when a new inquiry arrives. Who does what?
questions.why: Grounds AI suggestions in the actual handoff pattern.

questions.text: Where is the most copy-paste, retyping, or hunting for info in this phase?
questions.why: Email triage and brief intake are common Phase 1 wins here.

questions.text: What usually delays moving from inquiry to quote?
questions.why: Identifies bottlenecks AI can draft around, not replace.

wf_proposal.label: Proposal / Quote / Pricing
wf_proposal.description: Proposals, RFP responses, capability decks, pricing.

questions.text: Proposal / Quote — How does a quote or proposal get built today? (tools, templates, who writes)
questions.why: Validates ROI-02 and RFP-related priorities.

questions.text: What parts are always rewritten from scratch vs reused?
questions.why: Template + AI draft opportunities live here.

questions.text: Typical turnaround time today, and what would "fast enough" mean?
questions.why: Sets a KPI for quote automation.

wf_talent_sourcing.label: Talent Sourcing / Vetting
wf_talent_sourcing.description: How 1099 talent is discovered, vetted, onboarded, profiled.

questions.text: Talent Sourcing — How does someone new get onto the B9 roster end-to-end?
questions.why: Maps compliance-sensitive steps before suggesting AI.

questions.text: What is repetitive in vetting, onboarding, or profile updates?
questions.why: Job descriptions and FAQ bots may apply — with gates.

questions.text: Any geography or compliance concerns in this workflow? (NYC, IL, CA)
questions.why: Triggers hiring-law flags early.

wf_casting.label: Casting / Matching / Booking
wf_casting.description: Match talent to roles, client approval, confirm bookings.

questions.text: Casting / Matching — How do you go from brief to confirmed bookings?
questions.why: Human selection must stay central; AI is decision support only.

questions.text: Where do double-bookings, mismatches, or slow confirmations happen?
questions.why: Conflict detection and matching assist signals.

questions.text: How much of casting is art/judgment vs searchable criteria?
questions.why: Calibrates how far automation can go.

wf_pre_event.label: Pre-Event Prep / Logistics
wf_pre_event.description: Call sheets, briefings, brand training, travel, COIs.

questions.text: Pre-Event Prep — What gets assembled before talent hits the ground?
questions.why: Checklists and briefing docs are strong AI draft targets.

questions.text: What gets missed or rushed when timelines compress?
questions.why: Surfaces failure modes under pressure.

questions.text: Any brand training or quiz steps? Who owns them?
questions.why: ROI-06 compliance gates apply here.

wf_event_day.label: Event Day / Execution
wf_event_day.description: Check-in, real-time issues, supervision, no-show recovery.

questions.text: Event Day — What does coordination look like hour-by-hour?
questions.why: Informs ops-excellence branch and no-show workflows.

questions.text: What goes wrong most often? (no-shows, comms gaps, client surprises)
questions.why: Direct input to Branch B priorities.

questions.text: How are issues escalated and resolved today?
questions.why: AI can draft comms — humans still own recovery.

wf_post_event.label: Post-Event / Recap
wf_post_event.description: Recaps, client feedback, talent feedback, asset archival.

questions.text: Post-Event — How are recaps and follow-ups produced after an event?
questions.why: Validates ROI-03 recap automation.

questions.text: How long from event end to client receiving a recap?
questions.why: Baseline for 48-hour recap target.

questions.text: What makes a recap great vs acceptable?
questions.why: Quality bar for AI drafts.

questions.text: Finance — Walk through invoicing and talent payment after an event.
questions.why: Cash flow and audit use cases map here.

questions.text: Where do billing errors, delays, or manual reconciliation happen?
questions.why: ROI-11/12 signals.

questions.text: Any cash-flow visibility gaps leadership worries about?
questions.why: Weekly forecast routine candidate.

wf_comms_automation.label: Comms, WhatsApp & automation
wf_comms_automation.description: How messages flow today — and what Pete wants wired up.

questions.text: How does B9 talk to talent today? (text, WhatsApp, email, StaffConnect, phone — what do people actually use?)
questions.why: Maps real channels before recommending WhatsApp or SMS pilots.

questions.text: What would you automate first if you could wire WhatsApp or SMS to something else tomorrow?
questions.why: Surfaces Pete-style integration ideas without over-committing.

questions.text: What has to stay human-reviewed before anything sends? (clients, talent, both?)
questions.why: Sets assist vs automate boundary for messaging.

questions.text: Have talent opted in to business texts/WhatsApp? Any STOP/opt-out process today?
questions.why: TCPA gate — required before automated outbound.

questions.text: Who would build or maintain the wiring — Pete, a vendor, Andrew, someone on staff?
questions.why: Scopes L1 Zapier vs L2 API build realistically.
